ns2:section.sectionText: In order to register for this course, you will need to complete an Independent Study Form. The form can be found on our website: https://go.illinois.edu/GradIndependentStudy. The form must be completed before it's submitted. It must be signed by the Instructor, and must include the Course Subject/Number, # hours, and term. Once the form is completed, it may be sent to jajones6@illinois.edu for processing.
